title: Analog Input
text: Read from one or multiple analog input channels, 2 outputs, {Output data type} sets Data type of block output; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Input channels} selects analog input channels, {Input range} and {Block output signal} sets the value type returned. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Analog Data
ports.summary: Analog-to-digital converter data read from input channels vector

params.name: Install new board
params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Input range
params.values: Input range of analog inputs board dependent

params.name: Block output signal
params.values: Value type returned from block Volts (default) | Normalized bipolar | Normalized unipolar | Raw

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of block output double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
